meta.name: china-stock-analysis
meta.description: A股价值投资分析工具，提供股票筛选、个股深度分析、行业对比和估值计算功能。基于价值投资理论，使用akshare获取公开财务数据，适合低频交易的普通投资者。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 筛选A股并分析财务数据，辅助价值投资决策
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果平时用基本面分析做A股低频交易
copy.tagline_en: Screen A-shares and analyze financial data for value investing decisions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use fundamental analysis for low-frequency A-share trading

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据你提供的条件筛选A股、分析个股财务、对比同行业股票、计算内在价值，并检测财务异常风险。
howto.when: 当你要求分析某只A股、筛选股票、对比多只股票或计算估值时触发。

say.text: 帮我筛选沪深300中PE小于15、ROE大于15%的股票。
say.note: Claude会运行筛选脚本并返回结果表格。

say.text: 分析贵州茅台（600519）的财务健康状况。
say.note: Claude会获取财务数据并生成分析报告。

say.text: 对比贵州茅台、五粮液和洋河股份的估值。
say.note: Claude会进行行业对比并展示对比表格。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can screen A-shares based on your criteria, analyze individual stocks' financials, compare stocks within an industry, calculate intrinsic value, and detect financial anomalies.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to analyze an A-share stock, screen stocks, compare multiple stocks, or calculate valuation.

say_en.text: Screen stocks in the CSI 300 with PE < 15 and ROE > 15%.
say_en.note: Claude runs the screening script and returns a result table.

say_en.text: Analyze the financial health of Kweichow Moutai (600519).
say_en.note: Claude fetches financial data and generates an analysis report.

say_en.text: Compare the valuations of Kweichow Moutai, Wuliangye, and Yanghe.
say_en.note: Claude performs industry comparison and shows a comparison table.
